expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 09 was to explore the southwestern ridge arm of Wentworth seamount northwest of Kuaihelani (Midway) and investigate geological features that could help to provide clues to the age and provenance of the seamounts in this region. Another key goal was to characterize the ecosystem of this seamount ridge arm, including key faunal components and organismal interactions.
